title: Francesco Yates - JIMI
htmlContent:
Singer-songwriter and producer Francesco Yates returned with a new single “JIMI”, released on Sep 30, 2022. His style of music appeals to people because his lyrics speak about the realness of living life, the good and the bad. Francesco Yates is very proud of his new single “JIMI”, and he cannot wait for everyone to be able to hear it and have a good time with it. The sky's the limit for the upcoming artist Francesco Yates.
